title: Filthy cheap junk
text:
Filthy cheap junk. I give these one star because I wiped one down with a clean dry cotton cloth and it was black. I washed these in hot soapy water and the water was black from whatever nastiness was on them. I rinsed them and dried them under a heat lamp. After they got warm under the heat lamp and sat warm for 20 minutes I pulled one wiped with another clean white cotton cloth and guess what more black greasy dirt sweated out of the steel. Disappointed I repeated washing and heating until they wiped clean 3 more times. The lids stank and I couldn't wash that nasty smell off them. The material these bowls are stamped out of is very poor quality, thin, and cheap. I highly recommend never ever buying these. My recommendation is do some research first and buy quality American or European made stainless bowls and do not buy any from China. I am afraid to use these for food preparation they are for shop and outdoor uses because I don't want to get sick from whatever nastiness secretes from these bowls.
Again avoid these junk bowls I wish I would have.
